solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Move fast to arrest Scotsman dodging last lecture

indicators.note: to arrest someone is to hold them, so one piece is held inside the other
dodging the last means the final letter of the word is avoided and dropped

blocks.note: to hare is to run very fast
a typical Scottish man's name

explanation.surface: Someone races off to detain a Scot who is skipping the final lecture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Move fast' looks like part of the story, but it is a hare-like dash; Angus is the stock Scottish name in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: A harangue is a long, ranting speech, so a lecture in the scolding sense is a fair synonym.

clue.text: Consumed by champion endlessly, answer is drink

indicators.note: endlessly means without an end, so the last letter is cut
something consumed by another is swallowed inside it

blocks.note: to champion a cause is to advocate it; a supporter is an advocate
A is the abbreviation for answer

explanation.surface: A champion keeps drinking, swallowing everything, and that is the answer.
explanation.walkthrough: ADVOCATE without its final E is ADVOCAT, which takes A inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Advocaat is a Dutch liqueur made with eggs, sugar and brandy, so a drink.

clue.text: Key a retired factory worker has left inside

indicators.note: retired means withdrawn or gone back, so the word is read backwards up the column
has something inside means holds it, so the next piece goes within

blocks.note: taken as written
a mill is a factory
the worker ant is the crossword's favourite worker
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: A key retired factory hand has now left the building.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Factory worker' reads as one person, but it splits: the factory is reversed, then the worker holds PORT.
explanation.definitionFit: Key as an adjective means crucial, of the greatest importance, which is what all-important means.

clue.text: Count agreed with love message on wall

blocks.note: Graf is the German title for a count
to fit is to agree or match
love is zero in tennis, which looks like O

explanation.surface: A nobleman agrees to a love note being written on a wall.
explanation.definitionFit: A graffito is a single piece of graffiti, a message scrawled on a wall.

clue.text: Finish from George Best in picture — he's made successful run

indicators.note: the finish of a word is its final letter
in places the first piece within the second one

blocks.note: the last letter of George
to cap something is to outdo or best it
to picture something is to see it in your mind

explanation.surface: A film about footballer George Best ends with him making a winning run down the wing.
explanation.walkthrough: George Best was a famous Manchester United footballer; the name splits into separate words here.
explanation.definitionFit: An escapee is someone who has broken free, having run off successfully.

clue.text: Odds raised — that brings complaint

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means read upwards, so backwards

blocks.note: rum means odd, and the plural gives two of them

explanation.surface: A bookmaker lengthens the odds, which prompts a grumble from punters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Odds' looks like betting prices but stands for two odd things: RUM twice.
explanation.definitionFit: A murmur is a low, muttered grumble, a quiet expression of complaint.

clue.text: Compact mass the writer used for drying channel

blocks.note: a wad is a tight bundle or mass
the writer refers to the setter, I

explanation.surface: A writer uses a pressed wad of material to soak up water in a channel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drying' suggests mopping up, but describes a channel that dries out.
explanation.definitionFit: A wadi is a desert valley or watercourse that is dry except in the rainy season.

clue.text: Crime author one with wicked output?

blocks.note: first meaning: Raymond ..., the American writer of hardboiled detective novels
second meaning: a candle maker, whose products have wicks

explanation.walkthrough: 'Wicked' looks like evil, fitting crime, but means having wicks.
explanation.definitionFit: Raymond Chandler wrote crime fiction, and a chandler traditionally makes and sells candles.

clue.text: Strong drink like this with rum has to be managed

indicators.note: letters that have to be managed are handled and arranged into new order

blocks.note: so means in this way
the letters of these two words rearranged

explanation.surface: A bartender explains that a potent drink made this way, with rum, needs careful handling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rum' looks like part of the drink, but it is just anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Sour mash is an American whiskey made using some old mash, so it is a strong spirit.

clue.text: Match setting round ladies from the east?

indicators.note: in an across clue, reading from the east means reading right to left, so backwards

blocks.note: O is round in shape
the ladies is a women's toilet, a lav

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a sports venue has a ring of women coming in from the east.
explanation.walkthrough: THE OVAL is a London cricket ground, home of many Test matches.
explanation.definitionFit: The Oval is a famous cricket ground, the venue where a match is played.

clue.text: Painful thing's increase in prices constraining married mum

indicators.note: constraining means holding in, so the first phrase wraps around the next pieces

blocks.note: a general rise in prices
M is the standard abbreviation for married
ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: A painful thing for a married mother: rising prices squeezing her budget.
explanation.walkthrough: The two short pieces sit together in the middle of the price-rise word, not at its end.
explanation.definitionFit: An inflammation is a swollen, sore area of the body, a painful condition.

clue.text: Signal coaches reaching embassy — one to be deported

indicators.note: deported means sent away, so the letter for one is expelled from the word

blocks.note: railway coaches make up trains; also to coach is to train
a diplomatic mission is an embassy

explanation.surface: A signal arrives that coaches have reached the embassy and someone is being deported.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One' is the letter I, the Roman numeral, and it is the one sent away.
explanation.definitionFit: A transmission is a broadcast or message sent out, a signal in the sense of something transmitted.

clue.text: Dictator's to limit wages and capital claimed by PRC

indicators.note: a dictator here is someone dictating, speaking words aloud for another to write down

blocks.note: to tie pay is to restrict wages

explanation.surface: A tyrant plans to cap wages and seize a capital that the People's Republic of China claims.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dictator' suggests a tyrant, but it means someone dictating words, so the clue is about sound.
explanation.definitionFit: Taipei is the capital of Taiwan, which the People's Republic of China claims as its own territory.

clue.text: Sound passage consisting of eastern mysteries: fifty

blocks.note: E is the abbreviation for eastern
arcana are secrets or mysteries
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A guide describes a safe route made up of fifty Oriental secrets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like 'safe' or 'solid', but it means noise: the passage that carries it.
explanation.definitionFit: The ear canal is the tube through which sound travels to the eardrum.

clue.text: Second Mr Toad out to find celebrity

indicators.note: out here means disordered or not in its usual state, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: S is the abbreviation for second
these letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A second Mr Toad, of The Wind in the Willows, goes out seeking fame.
explanation.definitionFit: Stardom is the state of being a star, which is what celebrity means as an abstract noun.

clue.text: Tooth and what seats it leads to pain raging inside

indicators.note: the leads of words are their opening letters
inside tells us the selected letters go within the other word

blocks.note: a tooth sits in a socket in the jaw
the first letters of pain and raging

explanation.surface: A dentist warns that a tooth and its socket are causing raging pain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it' refers back to the tooth: what holds a tooth is a socket.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprocket is a projecting tooth on a wheel that engages a chain, so it is a kind of tooth.

clue.text: No prominent personality in a bubble

blocks.note: first meaning: a celebrity of the second rank, not an A-lister
second meaning: a fluid-filled swelling on the skin

explanation.surface: A minor celebrity is stuck in an isolated bubble.
explanation.walkthrough: The first meaning splits the word as B-LISTER, a second-tier star.
explanation.definitionFit: A blister is a small raised pocket of fluid under the skin, like a bubble, and a B-lister is a lesser celebrity.

clue.text: Game casserole almost cooked

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the final letter is left off
cooked means prepared or fiddled, so the letters are mixed into a new order

blocks.note: the word without its last letter

explanation.surface: A game casserole, made with pheasant or venison, is nearly done.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Game' looks like an adjective for the casserole's meat; it is the definition, a sport.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacrosse is a team sport played with netted sticks, so it is a game.

clue.text: Working away from maisonette altered value

indicators.note: away from means taken out of, so those letters are removed
altered means changed, so the remaining letters are reordered

blocks.note: a machine that is working is on
taken as written; a maisonette is a flat on two floors

explanation.surface: A surveyor, working away from a converted flat, revalues it.
explanation.definitionFit: To value something is to estimate what it is worth; both are verbs of judging price.

clue.text: After religious works, how he doubted his wife

blocks.note: OT is the Old Testament, a set of religious books
how is a greeting, as in the old 'How!'

explanation.surface: After reading scripture, a man wonders how he came to doubt his wife.
explanation.walkthrough: The greeting comes after the religious works, so OT leads.
explanation.definitionFit: Othello is Shakespeare's Moor, tricked by Iago into wrongly doubting his wife Desdemona.

clue.text: Ginger beer served at right temperature in crisis situation

blocks.note: ginger hair is reddish
ale is a type of beer
R is the abbreviation for right
T is the abbreviation for temperature

explanation.surface: Ginger beer served at the correct temperature would be welcome in an emergency.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ginger beer' reads as one drink but splits into a colour and a beer.
explanation.definitionFit: A red alert is the highest state of readiness, declared in an emergency.

clue.text: Cutting introduction, wrote about Area Nine

indicators.note: cutting the introduction means removing the opening letter
about means around, so the word goes round the next piece

blocks.note: to pen something is to write it
A is the abbreviation for area

explanation.surface: A writer drafts an introduction for a report about a place called Area Nine.
explanation.walkthrough: PENNED loses its first letter, leaving ENNED, which wraps around A.
explanation.definitionFit: An ennead is a group or set of nine, from the Greek for nine.

clue.text: Material around tip: unknown amount

blocks.note: C stands for circa, about
a tip is a hint or helpful piece of advice
in algebra x, y and z stand for unknown quantities

explanation.surface: A fabric buyer notes there is an uncertain quantity of cloth near the end of the roll.
explanation.definitionFit: Chintz is a printed, glazed cotton fabric, a kind of material.

clue.text: Grumpy about intelligence gathering vessel?

indicators.note: gathering means collecting in, so one word holds another inside it

blocks.note: CA is short for circa, about
nous is common sense or intelligence
a tanker is a ship carrying liquid

explanation.surface: Someone is bad-tempered about a spy ship gathering intelligence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Intelligence gathering' reads as spying, but intelligence is the word doing the gathering, with the vessel inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Cantankerous means bad-tempered and quarrelsome, the same mood as grumpy.

clue.text: Voters against in narrow winning margin reported

indicators.note: reported means told or spoken, so we go by how a word is said

blocks.note: a horse may win by a nose, the narrowest margin

explanation.surface: Opposition voters lose a ballot by a tiny margin, as the news reports.
explanation.walkthrough: In Parliament, those voting against a motion are the Noes.
explanation.definitionFit: The noes are the members voting against a motion, as in 'the noes have it'.

clue.text: One question about Gunners appearing in Arab republic

indicators.note: about here means surrounding, so the first pieces go round the next one

blocks.note: I is the Roman numeral one
Q is the abbreviation for question
RA is the Royal Artillery, whose soldiers are gunners

explanation.surface: Someone queries why Arsenal footballers, nicknamed the Gunners, are turning up in an Arab country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gunners' suggests Arsenal Football Club, but here it is the Royal Artillery.
explanation.definitionFit: Iraq is a republic in the Arab world, with Baghdad as its capital.

clue.text: Just take trip in twilight

blocks.note: even means fair or just
to take a trip is to stumble and fall

explanation.surface: Someone simply trips over in the fading light.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Just' looks like 'merely' but means fair; 'take trip' is a stumble, not a journey.
explanation.definitionFit: Evenfall is a poetic word for the onset of evening, the time of twilight.

clue.text: Plant imports drug to old German provinces

indicators.note: imports means brings in, so one piece is taken inside another

blocks.note: O is the abbreviation for old
the Länder are the federal states of Germany
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A factory brings narcotics into Germany's former regions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant' reads as a factory doing the importing; it is the definition, a shrub.
explanation.definitionFit: Oleander is an evergreen flowering shrub, a poisonous ornamental plant.
